agent_visits_completion_check.name: agent_visits_completion_check
agent_visits_completion_check.value: "agent_visits"."status" = 'in_progress' or ("agent_visits"."completed_at" is not null and "agent_visits"."result" is not null and "agent_visits"."duration_seconds" is not null)

dt_window_pair.name: dt_window_pair
dt_window_pair.value: ("delivery_tasks"."window_start" is null) = ("delivery_tasks"."window_end" is null) and ("delivery_tasks"."window_start" is null or "delivery_tasks"."window_start" < "delivery_tasks"."window_end")

pos_salary_range.name: pos_salary_range
pos_salary_range.value: "positions"."min_salary" IS NULL OR "positions"."max_salary" IS NULL OR "positions"."min_salary" <= "positions"."max_salary"
